tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the default ground for every component. Most of the screen is this.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Warm cream band for the hero, footer and the accessibility strip. Separate areas by this shift in ground, never by outlined boxes.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Image placeholders, the fit-score track, hover ground of quiet buttons and chips. ink, ink-muted and brand text all read on it (5.3:1, 4.8:1 light).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body copy on every surface token (min 12.9:1 light, 10.8:1 dark). Also the fill of selected chips and checked controls, the secondary emphasis colour.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, metadata, locations, timestamps on any surface token (min 5.3:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: selected chip, checked checkbox tick, done timeline dot (15.9:1).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control: text-input boxes (2px), radio and checkbox rings, the secondary button outline. 3.7:1 on surface, 3.4:1 on surface-alt, 3.0:1 on surface-sunken (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules between list rows and page sections. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The single accent. Spend it sparingly: the ONE primary button per view, the SearchBar's Szukaj button, the VoiceInput mic, success icons. Not for links, chips, checked states or decoration. As text 4.8:1+ on every surface (light).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand buttons.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the success Alert only. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-hover fills (5.9:1 light, 9:1 dark). Flips to near-black in dark: never hard-code white.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors only, always with an icon and words (WCAG 1.4.1). 5.0:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the error Alert and error summary. Text is ink; title danger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid outline, 3px offset, every interactive element. 12.9:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: flag-white
tokens.usage: Upper stripe of the 4px flag band at the very top of Header. Same in every theme. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: flag-red
tokens.usage: Lower stripe of the flag band, and one small block on the cover. Identity only: never errors, buttons or text.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Opisz problem. Pokażemy, co już działa.
styles.usage: One per page, home hero only. Drops to h1 under 480px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Exactly one h1 per page.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Pokażemy rozwiązania, które już działają w podobnych gminach.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Seniorzy w przysiółkach są samotni, autobus jeździ dwa razy dziennie.
styles.usage: Default copy. 18px base: the audience includes seniors and low-vision users.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, hints, footer. The smallest text in the system.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Status codes and anything a user must retype.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, Tag inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input, between Tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button inline gap, hint to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; Alert padding; default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields; page gutter from 768px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between list rows' content groups; Alert padding from 768px.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections from 768px; hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, checkboxes, small image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Alerts, StoryTile images, mobile sheets.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero image and large media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, the SearchBar and the rating options.

shadow.note: Flat UI: nothing in the page flow casts a shadow. One soft shadow for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, the mobile sheet, toasts.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, including inline icon buttons (exceeds AA; meets AAA 2.5.5).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and text inputs at default size.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for reading text.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; centred, gutters outside.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Display drops to h1 below; buttons go full-width below.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Gutters and section gaps step up; Header shows full nav.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Two-column layouts (results + filter rail) allowed.
